comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
In honor of Atlantis' return, a quick tip from this visiting old sea-dog.

After you have completed a Solar Barge quest for the week, if you choose to repeat it, then x1 of this item is awarded for doing so. You can take/report said quests from any GM in the world, which can make it easy to farm Edict boxes (like if one quest requires a discovery in Candia, you can use Athens for a base of operations).

The benefits? Well, your Ancient Technology Research points go up slightly if your Solar Barge gauge is filled up more via completing Imperial Quests related to the Solar Barge. More importantly, the Edict boxes give random (nice) drop rewards; the most valuable of which is:

Mysterious Gold x1

Mysterious Gold is a somewhat common drop from Edict boxes. It's used to make:

Statue of Ariadne - x1 M.Gold required. Increases the drop rate of M.Gold from Labyrinth dungeon boss chests for a set time. Don't know if it affects Orichalcum from the Temple of Poseidon dungeon too, but likely does not.
Minotaur's Axe - x10 + R15 Casting in a specific hidden room of the Labyrinth dungeon. IIRC, can be a 100 attk weapon with Great Success, but it's arguably more useful if transformed through Transmutation Alchemy to make...
Sagaris - Calls for Orichalcum and Alchemy/Casting R13, plus Special Purchase Bonds. EX Effect of: R15 Stamina Loss Reduction while in dungeons.

Edict boxes can only be farmed while Atlantis is present, which if JP-server models are any indication, will be about one month's time. Maris may run longer/shorter; either way, the Minotaur who drops M.Gold is somewhat rare as I recall, so consider taking advantage of Edict box farming while you can. Well, I leave the rest to you. Cheers.

Credit: LeVatiquois (retired) discovered the Edict trick first, a year ago. Just repeating it here.
